scenarios.title: A｜交通受影响
scenarios.setting: 玩家准备出发去另一个城市，但暴雨导致部分交通停运。

turns.text: Excuse me. Are the trains still running because of the weather?
Some services have been delayed or canceled because of the storm.

turns.prompt: 你想核实恶劣天气对原定列车的影响，会怎么说？

choices.text: Is my 3:20 train still running?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is my 3:20 train still running?
feedback.explanation: “still”强调原来的状态目前没有改变，是跟进进度或确认安排时的关键信息。

choices.text: Do you know how long the delays are?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you know how long the delays are?
feedback.explanation: “How long”询问持续时长，而不是具体几点。

choices.text: Has the 3:20 train been canceled?

feedback.naturalExpression: Has the 3:20 train been canceled?
feedback.explanation: 围绕一个具体动作或情况提问，让对方针对这一步确认或解释。

choices.text: Are there any trains still going to Brighton today?

feedback.naturalExpression: Are there any trains still going to Brighton today?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: Is my train influenced by the weather?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Is my 3:20 train still running?
feedback.explanation: 运行受天气影响常说“affected by the weather”；“influenced”更常描述行为、观点等受到影响。

turns.text: Your train has been canceled, but there’s another one scheduled for 5:10.

turns.prompt: 你想确认另一班列车是否正常运行、原票能否使用，会怎么说？

choices.text: Is the 5:10 train expected to run normally?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is the 5:10 train expected to run normally?
feedback.explanation: 用疑问句核对刚谈到的状态或条件，给对方确认和更正的机会。

choices.text: Can I use my current ticket on that train?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can I use my current ticket on that train?
feedback.explanation: 用问句确认自己能否这样做，既说明所需动作，也让对方有机会解释限制。

choices.text: Is there another way to get there earlier?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there another way to get there earlier?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: Is there a chance that one will be canceled too?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there a chance that one will be canceled too?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

turns.text: It may also be delayed if the weather gets worse.

turns.prompt: 关于「天气突然恶化」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay. I’ll keep checking the updates.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. I’ll keep checking the updates.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: In that case, I might look for another way to get there.

feedback.naturalExpression: In that case, I might look for another way to get there.
feedback.explanation: “in that case”表示根据刚得知的情况调整方案，让前后决定衔接起来。

choices.text: If it’s canceled too, can I get a refund?

feedback.naturalExpression: If it’s canceled too, can I get a refund?
feedback.explanation: “refund”指退款，指退还已支付的款项。

scenarios.title: B｜活动取消
scenarios.setting: 玩家原本预订了当天的户外活动，但因为天气原因无法进行。

turns.text: I’m afraid today’s boat tour has been canceled because of the weather.

turns.prompt: 你想了解活动取消的范围和后续安排，会怎么说？

choices.text: Oh, that’s unfortunate. Will it run tomorrow instead?

feedback.naturalExpression: Oh, that’s unfortunate. Will it run tomorrow instead?
feedback.explanation: “instead”表示改用另一种方案，能让对方知道原来的选择需要替换。

choices.text: Is the tour canceled for the whole day?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is the tour canceled for the whole day?
feedback.explanation: 用疑问句核对刚谈到的状态或条件，给对方确认和更正的机会。

choices.text: Can I move my booking to another day?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can I move my booking to another day?
feedback.explanation: “booking”指预订，酒店、交通和活动中都常用。

choices.text: What happens to the ticket I already paid for?

feedback.naturalExpression: What happens to the ticket I already paid for?
feedback.explanation: 问清后续处理或结果，能在行动前了解可能的影响。

choices.text: So we can’t do the activity because it’s raining too much?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Oh, that’s unfortunate. Will it run tomorrow instead?
feedback.explanation: 这句口语化但能正确确认取消原因；如果通知未说取消，应先核实是取消还是改期。

turns.text: You can reschedule for tomorrow or request a refund.

turns.prompt: 你想进一步确认时间，会怎么问？

choices.text: What time are the tours tomorrow?

feedback.naturalExpression: What time are the tours tomorrow?
feedback.explanation: “What time”请对方给出具体时点，适合确认开始、结束或赴约时间。

choices.text: Is the weather expected to be better tomorrow?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is the weather expected to be better tomorrow?
feedback.explanation: 用疑问句核对刚谈到的状态或条件，给对方确认和更正的机会。

choices.text: Could you move my booking to tomorrow morning?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you move my booking to tomorrow morning?
feedback.explanation: “booking”指预订，酒店、交通和活动中都常用。

choices.text: I’d prefer a refund if that’s possible.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d prefer a refund if that’s possible.
feedback.explanation: “refund”指退款，指退还已支付的款项。

turns.text: We have availability at 10 a.m. tomorrow.

turns.prompt: 关于「天气突然恶化」，你想提出一个接下来的做法或安排，会怎么建议？

choices.text: Great. Let’s move it to 10 a.m.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Let’s move it to 10 a.m.
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。

choices.text: Actually, I won’t be here tomorrow, so I’ll need a refund.

feedback.naturalExpression: Actually, I won’t be here tomorrow, so I’ll need a refund.
feedback.explanation: “refund”指退款，指退还已支付的款项。

scenarios.title: C｜改变计划
scenarios.setting: 原本的户外行程无法继续，玩家和同行人临时商量当天安排。

turns.text: Looks like the rain isn’t going to stop anytime soon. What should we do?

turns.prompt: 关于「天气突然恶化」，你想提出一个接下来的做法或安排，会怎么建议？

choices.text: Maybe we should do something indoors instead.

feedback.naturalExpression: Maybe we should do something indoors instead.
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。

choices.text: We could visit a museum and save the outdoor stuff for tomorrow.

feedback.naturalExpression: We could visit a museum and save the outdoor stuff for tomorrow.
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: Let’s check the weather for tomorrow before we decide.

feedback.naturalExpression: Let’s check the weather for tomorrow before we decide.
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。

choices.text: We could just take it easy today and change our plans for the rest of the trip.

feedback.naturalExpression: We could just take it easy today and change our plans for the rest of the trip.
feedback.explanation: “take it easy”表示放松、不紧绷，适合聊休息计划。

choices.text: Maybe we change our plan because the weather is bad.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Maybe we should do something indoors instead.
feedback.explanation: 提出调整建议可加“should”：“Maybe we should change our plans”，表明是建议而非既定事实。

turns.text: There’s an art museum about twenty minutes from here.

turns.prompt: 你想确认新的游览计划能否当天成行，会怎么说？

choices.text: That sounds good. Is it open today?

feedback.naturalExpression: That sounds good. Is it open today?
feedback.explanation: 明确表示接受刚提出的方案，让对方知道可以按这个安排继续。

choices.text: Let’s see if we need to book tickets in advance.

feedback.naturalExpression: Let’s see if we need to book tickets in advance.
feedback.explanation: “in advance”表示提前；用来确认手续或通知需要提前多久，能问清时间要求。

choices.text: How about going there now and finding somewhere to eat afterward?

feedback.naturalExpression: How about going there now and finding somewhere to eat afterward?
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。

choices.text: I’m fine with that, but I’d rather not spend too long getting there in this weather.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m fine with that, but I’d rather not spend too long getting there in this weather.
feedback.explanation: 把选择说成自己的偏好，可以表明立场，而不必否定另一种选择。

turns.prompt: 关于「天气突然恶化」，你想提出一个接下来的做法或安排，会怎么建议？

choices.text: Perfect. Let’s go there, then.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. Let’s go there, then.
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。

choices.text: Great. We can rearrange tomorrow’s plans later tonight.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. We can rearrange tomorrow’s plans later tonight.
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。
